name: mlt
description: The MLT package is the Media Lovin Toolkit. It is an open source multimedia framework, designed and developed for television broadcasting. It provides a toolkit for broadcasters, video editors, media players, transcoders, web streamers and many more types of applications.

user:
cmake -B build -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release  \
      -D MOD_SOX=OFF               \
      -D MOD_MOVIT=OFF             \
      -D MOD_VIDSTAB=OFF           \
      -D MOD_JACKRACK=OFF          \
      -D MOD_RUBBERBAND=OFF        \
      -W no-dev ..
